_note: Geometry for the schematic map of the project. Tunnel routes are drawn smoothly from point to point: no alignment has been studied. Corridor lengths are planning estimates read from maps; the link is 5 km (4.5 to 6). The Seine and the existing lines are sketched by hand for orientation.

stations.name: Paris Nord-Est
stations.where: Under and between Gare du Nord and Gare de l’Est, which are 500 m apart.
stations.calls: Trains of all four lines stop here: from the north, the east, the south-east and the Atlantic. One of the six TGV tracks can be closed off for each London departure.
stations.surface: Both halls become entrances. The surface platforms and the approach tracks of both stations become a park.
stations.under: under Gare du Nord and Gare de l’Est

stations.name: Gare de Lyon
stations.calls: Trains of all four lines: those of the south-east, and the half of the northern, eastern and Atlantic trains that pair with them. A junction at the city end leads to the direct link to Montparnasse.
stations.surface: The hall is kept as the entrance. The surface tracks towards Bercy become a park.

stations.name: Montparnasse
stations.calls: Trains of all four lines: those of the Atlantic, and the half of the northern, eastern and south-eastern trains that pair with them. A junction at the city end leads to the direct link to Gare de Lyon.
stations.surface: The hall is kept as the entrance. The surface tracks towards the ring road become a park.

junctions.name: Northern junction
junctions.what: Where the corridors from the north and from the east meet, just before the station.

junctions.name: Southern junction
junctions.what: Where the tunnels to Gare de Lyon and to Montparnasse part, just after the station.

junctions.name: Montparnasse junction
junctions.what: Where the direct link to Gare de Lyon leaves the corridor from Nord-Est, at the city end of Montparnasse. Its geometry has not been designed.

junctions.name: Gare de Lyon junction
junctions.what: Where the direct link from Montparnasse joins the corridor from Nord-Est, at the city end of Gare de Lyon. Its geometry has not been designed.
